data.title: Keep moving with confidence.
data.subtitle: Friendly workshop and onsite support for mobility scooters, wheelchairs, and powerchairs across Auckland.

content.en:
Based in Mt Wellington, The Repair Hub provides practical mobility-access servicing, repairs, replacement parts, pickup and drop-off support, and call-out visits.

Explore our repair projects, services, and parts to find the right next step.

pages.title: About The Repair Hub
pages.meta_title: About The Repair Hub | Mobility access specialists
pages.meta_description: Learn about The Repair Hub's workshop-based and onsite mobility access support in Auckland.

content.en:
The Repair Hub specialises in mobility access and scooters, with more than 10 years of experience stated on the public website.

The workshop is based in Mt Wellington and the service network covers greater Auckland with onsite and pickup/drop-off options.
